messages:
tara: Quick shoutout to samir and li for staying late to debug the RAG index drift — the support call went way smoother because of you both :sparkles:

samir: huge team effort. li spotted a tiny serialize typo that cascaded into bad keys. pushed a hotfix and a short test.

li: added the fix + an e2e check in PR 5678 — https://git.internal/r/5678 — thanks for jumping on the call, tara.

brenda: awesome work. i pinned a short postmortem note in the incident board: https://wiki.internal/incidents/rag-drift-2026 — clear steps for follow-up.

tara: can we add a 1-line note to the release changelog so app teams know the behavioral change?

people-ops: done — i added a "thanks" badge for samir & li on this week's kudos board :trophy:

ops-bot: Reminder: late-night on-call meal vouchers available. Claim here: https://ops.internal/meals — valid for tonight only.

brenda: Also — proposal: sticker idea "Serialize Sherpa" for infra folks. who votes yes? (poll)

samir: yes +1 — would wear that on my laptop :wink:

li: yes. small sticker + maybe a matching enamel pin?

tara: sending a tiny cake emoji to the thread — thanks again team! :cake:

people-ops: We'll coordinate sticker mockups with design and post a short order form tomorrow.
